user.title: Add a timer
user.description: Pick the entity that the timer turns on and off.

data_description.target: The switch, light, fan or other entity to run on a timer.
data_description.mode: Strict runs the entity only while the timer counts down. Loose also lets it run without a timer.

duration.title: Default duration
duration.description: How long the entity runs when it is turned on without a duration.

error.target_not_supported: A timer cannot turn this entity on and off. Pick another one.
error.duration_not_whole: The duration must be a whole number of minutes.

abort.already_configured: This entity already has a timer.

data_description.mode: Strict runs the entity only while the timer counts down. Loose also lets it run without a timer.

duration.title: Default duration
duration.description: How long the entity runs when it is turned on without a duration.

error.duration_not_whole: The duration must be a whole number of minutes.

options.strict: Strict: runs only while the timer counts down
options.loose: Loose: may also run without a timer

add_time.name: Add time
add_time.description: Adds minutes to the countdown of a timer, or takes them off with a negative number. Adding to a timer that is not running starts it; taking off all the time that is left turns the entity off. A countdown never goes beyond one day.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: How many minutes to move the end of the countdown by, up to a day either way.

run.name: Run
run.description: Turns the entity on without saying for how long: for the default duration in strict mode, without a countdown in loose mode.

target_not_found.message: The entity this timer was set up for no longer exists. Remove this timer and add it again for another entity.

not_whole_minutes.message: Run for takes a whole number of minutes; {minutes} is not one.
